title: Gear
description: Your own rental fleet — who has what, when it's due back, and what's due for service.

stats.outNowDetail: Checked out and not yet home
stats.dueBackOverdueDetail: {count, plural, one {# already overdue} other {# already overdue}}

returns.title: Due back
returns.description: Everything that should come through the door today — close each one out as it comes home.

empty.heading: No gear on the register yet
empty.body: Add your first tagged unit — a BCD, a regulator, a tank — and DiveDay will track who has it, when it's due back, and when it needs service. Shops that don't track units lose nothing: sizes and the prep list work exactly as before.

addUnit.title: Add a unit
addUnit.description: One row per physical thing on the wall, tagged the way you'd say it out loud.

notice.deletedToast: Unit deleted. Its service and rental history went with it.
notice.returned: Marked returned — the unit is home.
notice.alreadyCheckedOut: That unit is already out the door — mark it returned instead.
notice.invalid: That didn't save — check the form and try again.
notice.emptyLabel: Give the unit a tag — it's how you'll find it with wet hands.
notice.duplicateLabel: Another unit already wears that tag.
notice.invalidDate: That date doesn't exist — check it.
notice.dueNotAfterService: The next due date has to come after the service date.
notice.allHome: All home — every unit is back on the wall.
notice.invalidDives: Dives has to be a whole number above zero.
notice.divesNeedADate: A dive count needs a due date beside it — the unit is due at whichever comes first.

service.title: Service
service.noClocks: No service on record yet — log the first one below and the clocks start from there.
service.nextDueHint: When this clock runs out. Annual service and inspections usually a year out; hydro five.
service.nextDueDivesHint: Manufacturers publish both — 24 months or 100 dives. Needs a next-due date too.

details.title: Details
details.description: The tag, size, and serial the register lists this unit by.

status.title: Status
status.pullNote: Why it's coming off the wall
status.deleteWarning: Deleting removes its service and rental history too. A unit that earned its keep gets retired instead.

prep.heading: Rental assignments
prep.description: Which tagged unit each renting diver takes. Assigning here reserves it for the departure's dates — two divers can't be promised the same one.

notice.unitUnavailable: Somebody got that unit first — pick another.
notice.unitOutOfService: That unit is off the wall for service.
notice.alreadyCheckedOut: That unit already left the counter — mark it returned from the register instead.
